description: Download an Item Priority feed file to track changes (deltas) in the status of priority items, such as when an item is added or removed from a campaign. Required consuming daily feeds first.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: The formats that the client accepts for the response.

parameters.name: X-EBAY-C-MARKETPLACE-ID
parameters.description: The ID of the eBay marketplace where the item is hosted.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Header specifying content range to be retrieved. Example: bytes=0-102400.
